Two peer-reviewed publications exploring machine learning, network structure, and earlier human review.

NHSJS & CurieuxMay 2024–August 2025Advisor: Dr. Hongliang Wang

Natural language processing

Suicide-risk post classification.

Built classifiers to flag Reddit posts for early human review, comparing a fine-tuned BERT model with decision tree and LSTM-CNN baselines.

Accuracy
97%
AUC
0.991
Dataset
16,000 posts

Network modeling

How harmful content spreads.

Modeled harmful-content propagation on a Reddit network using an SIR epidemic model. Targeting the most connected users reduced affected users by 6.8%, more than three times the reduction achieved by other strategies.

Network
7,067 users
Reduction
6.8%
Method
SIR model

The role of human judgment.

I consulted psychologist Shuang Cui on the ethics of automated mental-health screening, framing the model as triage for limited moderator attention. The reported results come from research datasets and simulations.
